  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Robust MAD scaling}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
---

```{r}
library(veryMAD)
mad_scale(c(1, 2, 100))
```

For matrices, `margin = 1` scales rows and `margin = 2` scales columns. Matrix
dimensions and names are preserved; numeric data frames are returned as
matrices. A MAD-based scale is robust to extreme values and differs from a
standard deviation-based z-score. Zero-MAD margins can return zeros, `NA`, or
an error through `zero_mad`.
